name: PLINTAS
recent: Prolintas Infra Business Trust 公布 2026 财年第二季度业绩，净利按年增长 13.4%，并宣布每单位 3.18 仙的首次中期收入分配。公司同时出现首席人员变动及多个委员会成员调整。
notable: 宣布 2026 财年首次中期收入分配，每单位 3.18 仙。
2026 年第二季度净利按年增长 13.4%。
首席人员及多个董事会委员会成员出现变动。
risks: 净利按季下降 35.4%，净利率由 16.6% 降至 10.8%。
earnings: 2026 年第二季度营收为 MYR 80.30 million，按年微降 0.6%，按季下降 0.4%；净利为 MYR 8.65 million，按年增长 13.4%，但按季下降 35.4%。净利率为 10.8%，低于上一季度的 16.6%。

recent_en: Prolintas Infra Business Trust reported 2Q 2026 earnings with net profit up 13.4% year-on-year and declared a first interim income distribution of 3.18 sen per unit. The company also saw changes in principal officers and several committee members.
notable_en: Declared first interim income distribution of 3.18 sen per unit for FY2026.
Changes in principal officers and several board committee members.
risks_en: Net profit fell 35.4% quarter-on-quarter, with net margin declining from 16.6% to 10.8%.
earnings_en: 2Q 2026 revenue was MYR 80.30 million, down 0.6% year-on-year and 0.4% quarter-on-quarter; net profit was MYR 8.65 million, up 13.4% year-on-year but down 35.4% quarter-on-quarter. Net margin was 10.8%, lower than 16.6% in the previous quarter.
